text:
Indian benchmarks ended almost flat on 12 Nov 2026, while smallcaps and realty outpaced them.

• Nifty 50 closed at 25,299.35, up 0.18%, and Sensex at 81,911.01, up 0.04%, per Kotak Neo and ChiniMandi closing reports.
• Nifty Smallcap 100 rose about 1.1%, and Nifty Realty was the standout sector gainer with a rise of more than 3.5%, per the same reports.
• IT and FMCG indices ended lower, with both Kotak Neo and ChiniMandi showing declines of roughly 0.4% to 0.7%.
• Kotak Neo described the session as volatile and range-bound, sensitive to global cues, crude oil and geopolitical developments.

Our view: a flat index can hide a lot of movement underneath. When smallcaps and realty rise while IT and FMCG slip, it may suggest rotation within the market rather than a change in overall direction, though one session says little on its own. This is an interpretation of the data, not a forecast.

For practitioners: when benchmarks are flat but breadth and sector returns diverge, which indicators do you look at first to understand what is really happening?
